description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests for setting IP configurations (both IPv4 and IPv6) on a network device, including validation and applying the settings.

methods.name: isValidIP
methods.description: Validates whether an IP address falls within a specified IP range.

methods.name: ipRange
methods.description: Calculates the start and end IP addresses of the subnet based on gateway address and subnet mask.

methods.name: valid_GW_IP
methods.description: Checks if a gateway IP is within the specified IP range and has the last octet as '1'.

methods.name: isValidGW
methods.description: Validates the gateway IP based on class and subnet mask restrictions and checks if the provided address range includes the gateway IP.
